_comment: FORGE backend catalogue ENGLISH – mirror of de.json. Filled from step 5 (notify.js) onwards.
notify.act.self_heal: Nothing to do – the bot will catch up automatically on the next cycle.
notify.act.observe: Nothing to do. Keep an eye on the pool in the dashboard – the bot steps in by itself when needed.
notify.act.fyi: Nothing to do, this message is for your information only.
notify.act.in_wallet: Nothing to do. The capital is in your wallet – you can leave it there or invest it again.
notify.act.in_position: Nothing to do. The capital is part of the open position – you can leave it there.
notify.act.retrying: The bot will try again. If this message appears several times in a row, restart the bot.
notify.act.in_wallet_retrying: The capital is in your wallet, but the position is not fully closed yet. The bot will finish that automatically. If this message appears several times in a row, check the pool in the dashboard.
notify.act.manual: Please check the dashboard and then release the pool again by hand.
notify.act.top_up: Please top up the wallet with at least 0.15 SOL.
notify.act.configure: Please set the value again in the dashboard under Risk Management.
notify.act.verify: Nothing was adopted automatically. Please verify the details before giving the pool more capital.
notify.common.logref: Too technical for a short message – details: `{cmd}`
notify.err.insufficient_funds: Not enough balance for the transaction
notify.err.liquidity_underflow: Position liquidity changed in the meantime (stale read)
notify.err.close_not_empty: The position still held liquidity when closing (stale read)
notify.err.routing: Routing error during the swap (the market price moved while calculating)
notify.hadv.act: Please check the services listed above. The full report with all findings is available via `node bin/health-advisor.js --report`.
notify.liq.shutdown_expected:
🔴 *Liquidity Bot stopped* ({reason})
Open positions remain, they are simply no longer managed. Nothing to do if you triggered the stop yourself.
notify.liq.shutdown_unexpected:
🔴 *Liquidity Bot stopped* ({reason})
The stop was not planned. Nothing to do – the service restarts automatically. If no start message follows, please check the bot status in the dashboard.
notify.liq.tier_tail_withdraw: The pool's rating has dropped to WITHDRAW. The bot closes the position automatically as soon as risk management kicks in – you can also close it yourself in the dashboard right away.
notify.liq.tier_tail_invest: The pool is attractive again. Nothing to do – the bot adds capital by itself on the next cleanup run if any is free.
notify.liq.tvl_warn:
⚠️ *TVL warning threshold* – {pair}
Current: {current} USDC (threshold: {threshold} USDC)
There is less outside capital in the pool than expected – that lowers the fees and makes exiting harder.
Nothing to do yet. If the value keeps falling the bot withdraws the capital automatically; you can also close the position in the dashboard before that.
notify.liq.capital_recovered:
*Deposit booked retroactively* – {pair}
A deposit of {usd} USDC from {when} had landed on-chain but was never booked in the database (TX {tx}). It has now been added, PnL and capital are correct again.
notify.liq.fee_measurement_rejected:
*Faulty measurement discarded* – {pair}
Pending fees were measured at {measured} USDC against a position value of {lp} USDC – that would be a return of {apr}% per year, so it is not a measurement but a misread of the chain. The value was discarded, the last valid one of {previous} USDC still applies – only the display was affected, not your capital.
notify.liq.capital_unclear_out:
*Withdrawal not booked yet* – {pair}

On {when} the bot took capital out of this pool ({tx}), but it was interrupted and could not finish booking the operation. Your capital is complete — it is in your wallet, only the internal record of it is missing.
notify.liq.capital_unclear_in:
*Deposit not booked yet* – {pair}
On {when} capital went into this pool (TX {tx}) that the bot could not add by itself: {reason}. Your capital is complete — it is part of the open position, only the internal record of it is missing. While it is missing, the profit shown for this pool may be too high.
notify.liq.capital_reason_no_valuation: the measurements needed to determine its value at the time of the deposit are missing
notify.liq.capital_reason_mismatch: the position's value did not rise by the same amount ({jump} USDC), the two numbers do not add up
_comment.legacy.capital_unclear: LEGACY – no longer emitted, but kept: stored notifications reference their msg_key forever and would otherwise render as the raw key. Superseded by notify.liq.capital_unclear_out / _in.
notify.liq.capital_unclear:
*Capital movement not yet assigned* – {pair}
On {when} there was a transaction in this pool (TX {tx}) that couldn't be booked automatically: {reason}. Nothing was lost.
notify.liq.open_position_gave_up:
{pair}: automatic opening stopped after {fails} failed attempts ({context}) – {reason}. The pool was deactivated, the capital is in your wallet.
{detail}
notify.liq.sol_low_critical: The SOL reserve is currently {sol} SOL. The bot can no longer top itself up – it lacks even the transaction fee needed to swap into SOL.
notify.liq.sol_low:
The SOL reserve is currently {sol} SOL. Below {reserve} SOL no new positions are opened.
Please top up the wallet with at least 0.15 SOL or wait until the SOL balance recovers.
notify.liq.sol_recovered: The SOL reserve is currently {sol} SOL. New positions are being opened again from now on.
notify.liq.sol_topup_failed:
🔴 *Not enough SOL*
Could not obtain enough SOL {when} (currently {sol} SOL). There is no balance in the wallet that could be swapped into SOL.
{action} Without SOL the bot cannot close the position.
notify.liq.min_value_cleared:
The pool minimum value ({value} USDC) was disabled on the Trailing Stop, {cause}.
While the minimum value is unset this protection does not apply. {action}
notify.liq.min_value_cause_rebalance: because the pool value is too close to the minimum after rebalancing
notify.liq.min_value_cause_withdraw: because coins were withdrawn from the pool
notify.liq.rm_warning:
⚠️ *Risk management: event imminent*
*{scenario}* reached.
The bot is about to close the position automatically and swap the proceeds into USDC. Nothing to do – only step in if you deliberately want to keep the position.
notify.liq.rm_executed:
ℹ️ *{scenario}* – {pair}
Position closed automatically.

```
| Metric | Value |
|---|---:|
| Invested | {investValue} |
| Entry cost | {entryCostValue} |
| Peak | {hwmValue} |
| Before exit | {lpValue} USDC |
| Exit cost | {costValue} |
| Paid out | {swappedValue} |
| PnL | {pnlValue} |
```
Removed: {coinsA} {symA} + {coinsB} {symB}{noSwapSuffix}
notify.liq.rm_label_trailing_s2: Trailing stop stage 2 – locking in profit ({pct}%)
notify.liq.score_limit_triggered:
Risk management: Opportunity Score <{minScore}
The pool's rating fell below your minimum threshold, the position was closed.
notify.liq.exit_sent_action: Nothing to do. The capital was transferred to the address you configured.
notify.liq.trailing_stop_triggered:
Trailing Stop: {drawdown}% loss since the high-water mark
High: {hwm} USDC → current: {current} USDC
The loss limit you set has been reached, the position is being closed.
Nothing to do – the proceeds land in your wallet, the completion message follows.
notify.liq.param_check_action: The rating parameters no longer match market behaviour well. Please open the Score Adviser in the dashboard and review the suggested values.
notify.liq.premium_retired_absent: It is missing from the data service's offer list.
notify.liq.premium_retired_explicit: The data service explicitly downgraded it.
notify.liq.premium_reinstated:
*Downgrade revoked* – {pair}
The data service offers the pool again. The planned automatic exit is cancelled.
notify.liq.premium_own_tvl: Own measurement at the time of the exit: pool TVL {tvl} USDC.
notify.liq.deposit_check_ok:
✅ *Test deposit works again* – {pair}
The error reported earlier is gone. The pool can take capital again once it leads the ranking.
notify.liq.premium_updated_deferred:
Deferred while capital sits in the pool (it changes the calculation of running positions):
{lines}
notify.liq.new_pools.known_pair: ⚠️ Pair already running as {pool} ({id}, {fee} %) — new pool: {newFee} %
notify.len.act.in_wallet: Nothing to do. The capital is in your wallet and will be reinvested on the next Auto-Deploy.
notify.len.act.top_up: Please top up the wallet with at least 0.15 SOL – without SOL the bot cannot send transactions any more.
notify.len.act.top_up_retry: The bot will try again on the next cycle. If the message persists, please top up the wallet manually with at least 0.15 SOL.
notify.len.act.self_healed: Nothing to do, the bot took care of itself.
notify.len.act.observe_pool: Nothing to do. Keep an eye on the pool in the dashboard – the bot exits by itself when the exit threshold is reached.
notify.len.act.check_pool: The capital is still in the pool. The bot will try again – if the message persists, please check the dashboard.
notify.len.act.wait_pool: Nothing to do. The money stays in the wallet until a suitable pool is available again.
notify.len.act.enable_pool: Nothing to do. If you want to use the pool again, activate it in the settings.
notify.len.act.restart_hint: The bot keeps running. If this message appears repeatedly, please restart the bot.
notify.len.act.auto_restart: Nothing to do – the service restarts automatically. If no start message follows, please check the bot status in the dashboard.
notify.len.act.support: Please contact support – the remainder has to be re-staked by hand.
notify.len.act.check_dashboard: Please check the dashboard. If the message appears repeatedly, restart the bot.
notify.len.leftover_lp: ⚠️ {lp} unstaked LP tokens{usdc} left in the wallet – contact support (re-staking required).
notify.len.deploy_skipped_unavailable:
⚠️ *Auto-Deploy skipped*
Protocol "{pool}" not available (mode: invest in X).
notify.len.deploy_skipped_disabled:
⚠️ *Auto-Deploy skipped*
Pool "{pool}" is deactivated – reactivate it in the settings UI if you want to use it.
notify.len.deploy_skipped_no_pools:
⚠️ *Auto-Deploy skipped*
+{funds} USDC detected, but no qualified pools available.
notify.len.deploy_skipped_tvl:
⚠️ *Auto-deploy skipped*
Pool "{pool}": TVL {value} USDC is below the TVL protection threshold ({threshold} USDC) – a deposit would be withdrawn again right away.
notify.len.deploy_skipped_liq:
⚠️ *Auto-deploy skipped*
Pool "{pool}": withdrawable liquidity {value} USDC is below the liquidity protection threshold ({threshold} USDC) – deposited capital would not be accessible.
notify.len.deploy_skipped_no_tvl:
⚠️ *Auto-deploy skipped*
Pool "{pool}": no current TVL reading available – without it the TVL protection cannot work.
notify.len.deploy_skipped_no_liq:
⚠️ *Auto-deploy skipped*
Pool "{pool}": no current liquidity reading available although this protocol normally provides it – without it the liquidity protection cannot work.
notify.len.deploy_skipped_basis:
⚠️ *Auto-deploy skipped*
Pool "{pool}": not enough data ({points} of {minPoints} readings, {hours}h of {minHours}h observed) – the average APY is not yet reliable.
notify.len.deploy_capped: (capped from {rest} USDC, the rest stays in the wallet for the next run)
notify.len.sol_critical:
⚠️ *SOL reserve critical*
{sol} SOL in the wallet – not enough USDC for an automatic top-up ({usdc} USDC).
notify.len.sol_topup_done:
🔋 *SOL top-up executed*
{usdc} USDC → {sol} SOL
Reserve was: {before} SOL
notify.len.lp_remainder_short: ⚠️ {pool}: {lp} unstaked LP tokens{usdc} left in the wallet after the withdrawal – no longer visible in Loopscale, but present on-chain. Contact support (re-staking required).
notify.len.position_vanished:
🚨 *Position vanished*
Pool: {pool}
Book value: {amount} USDC
The protocol has reported this position as empty several times in a row, even though no withdrawal took place. The amount has been removed from the balance.
notify.len.position_vanished_short: 🚨 {pool}: position worth {amount} USDC vanished – no withdrawal, amount written off
notify.len.act.position_vanished: Please check in the protocol whether the capital can still be found, and contact support – the bot cannot recover it.
notify.len.position_reconciled:
♻️ *Position restored*
Pool: {pool}
Amount: {amount} USDC
The protocol reports capital again even though the DB position was marked closed (e.g. after a re-stake). The bot re-opened the position automatically, cost basis = current value.
notify.len.position_reconciled_short: ♻️ {pool}: {amount} USDC found again – position re-opened automatically
msg.premium.activate_in.detail: A client requested a premium activation.
msg.premium.activate_out.detail: Activation request sent to the FORGE Master.
msg.premium.health_share_apply_out.detai: Application for system data sharing sent to the FORGE Master – including exactly one sample report so you can see what would be transmitted. No further data is sent until the Master approves.
msg.premium.health_share_apply_in.detail: An installation is applying for system data sharing and included a sample report.
msg.premium.health_share_approved_out.de: An installation was confirmed for system data sharing.
msg.premium.health_share_revoked_out.det: An installation had its system data sharing withdrawn.
msg.premium.health_share_report_in.detai: An approved installation sent its hourly system data report.
msg.premium.health_share_report_out.deta: The hourly system data report was sent to the FORGE Master – this covers the next hour of Premium.
msg.premium.token_in.detail: An activation token was received – premium is active.
msg.premium.token_out.detail: An activation token was sent to a requesting peer.
msg.premium.blob.detail: New premium data was delivered and processed automatically{range}.
msg.premium.blob_sealed_out.detail: Encrypted premium data was sent to a paying customer.
msg.premium.autopay_on.detail: From now on payment happens automatically every hour and the market data is refreshed every 10 minutes in the background – there is no separate message for that any more. You will only be notified about balance problems or if the premium service is temporarily unreachable.
msg.premium.autopay_off_bot.summary: Premium service deactivated – Liquidity Bot stopped
msg.premium.autopay_off_bot.detail: The Liquidity Bot was stopped manually, and premium delivers market data for it – automatic payment was therefore deactivated as well. Reactivate it via Liquidity → Premium → Manage once the bot is running again.
msg.premium.autopay_off.detail: No further automatic payments will be made.
msg.premium.pay_failed_balance.summary: ⚠️ Premium service deactivated – out of balance
msg.premium.pay_failed_balance.detail: The balance in the premium wallet is no longer sufficient ({needed} USDC required, {have} USDC available). The premium service was therefore deactivated – no further automatic payments will be attempted. Please top up the balance in USDC and reactivate the premium service via Liquidity → Premium → Manage!
msg.premium.pay_failed.detail: The transaction could not be executed ({detail}). Possible cause: not enough SOL for the network fee. Please top up the wallet with at least 0.15 SOL – automatic payment resumes with the next successful attempt.
msg.premium.outage.detail: The premium service is temporarily unreachable. The hourly payments were suspended and resume automatically once the service is reachable again.
msg.premium.outage_over.detail: Automatic payments continue as normal from now on.
msg.premium.strategy_rollback.detail: The premium service has ended – the strategy has therefore been switched back to Standard, {reverted} field(s) were reset to their state before the strategy. {skipped} field(s) were left unchanged (changed by hand, or a tightening on an open position). To run a strategy again, select one under Liquidity → Strategy.
msg.premium.version_in.detail: A fork reported its software version ({version}).
msg.premium.version_out.detail: Reported own software version to the FORGE Master.
msg.premium.version_old_in.detail: The installed version ({yourVersion}) is older than the required minimum version {minVersion}. The premium service may not work correctly and was therefore deactivated. Please update FORGE public and reactivate the premium service via Liquidity → Premium → Manage afterwards.
msg.premium.version_old_out.detail: Reported minimum version {minVersion} to an outdated peer.
msg.support.alias_failed: The alias could not be set: {error}
msg.support.account_failed: The account could not be recreated: {error}
msg.support.master_no_reset: The FORGE Master must not be reset – its npub has to stay stable so that all peers (FORGE public forks among them) can still reach it. The display name can still be changed via /identity/alias.
msg.support.health_share_no_reset: The Nostr access cannot be changed while a Premium access via data sharing exists – the approval is tied to this exact access and would be lost if you switch. First clear the checkbox in the Health Monitor under "Host", after that the change is possible.
msg.support.reset_confirm_missing: Confirmation missing: confirm=true is required. Careful – the current Nostr account and ALL messages are deleted irrevocably.
msg.support.invalid_peer: peerPubkey must be a valid npub1… or a 64-character hex pubkey
msg.support.nostr_not_ready: Nostr service not ready (identity missing or relays unreachable)
msg.support.premium_no_stream: The premium service did not return a stream

notify.upd.act_discarded: Nothing to do – the update was discarded, the running version remains unchanged. If this message keeps appearing, do not install any updates by hand and contact the publisher.
notify.upd.act_verify_publisher: Verify via the publisher's Nostr identity whether this key change is genuine. Until that is confirmed, do not install any further updates.
notify.upd.act_confirm: Please confirm the update in the backend so it gets installed.
notify.upd.act_after_rollback: Nothing to do – the previous version is running again. Please check in the backend that all bots are active again.
notify.upd.act_urgent: The bots are currently NOT running and your capital is not being monitored. Please check the backend immediately and restore the services by hand.
notify.upd.act_check_install: Without a trust anchor no update can be verified. Please check the installation with "sudo bin/setup.sh status".
notify.upd.act_watch_channel: Nothing to do – the older version was not installed. If this message keeps appearing, verify via the publisher's Nostr identity whether a release was really withdrawn.
notify.upd.act_fetch_retry: Nothing to do – the next automatic check will try again. If this persists for several days, check this machine's internet connection.
notify.upd.trust_missing:
*Update check not possible – trust anchor missing*
The file with the publisher's verification keys is missing from this installation. It is therefore impossible to tell whether an offered update is genuine. Nothing was installed.
notify.upd.sig_invalid:
*Update rejected – invalid signature*
An offered update did not carry a valid signature from the publisher. That means it either does not come from him or was modified in transit. Nothing was installed.
notify.upd.recovery_key:
*Publisher has switched the signing key*
This update was not signed with the publisher's usual key but with his recovery key. This is intended for the case that his main key was stolen — but it can also mean someone else holds the recovery key.
notify.upd.downgrade:
*Update source offers an older version*
The update source offers version {offered}, but {installed} is already installed. Older versions are never installed – they could bring back security issues that have already been fixed.
notify.upd.integrity:
*Update rejected – content modified (v{version})*
The publisher's signature was valid, but the downloaded package does not match what he signed. It was therefore modified after signing. Nothing was installed.
notify.upd.symlinks:
*Update rejected – suspicious links in the package (v{version})*
The package contains file links that could lead outside the intended directory. This does not belong in a regular update. Nothing was installed.
notify.upd.apply_failed:
*Update failed – version {version}*
Installing was aborted with an error (code {code}). The installation may be in an incomplete state.
notify.upd.apply_ok:
*Update installed – version {version}*
The update was installed and all services are running normally again.
notify.upd.stopped_migration:
*Update failed – automatic rollback not possible (v{version})*
After the update the services are not running correctly. Affected services: {services}. This update migrated the database, so an automatic rollback would be more dangerous than the current state – the old version no longer matches the migrated data. The services were stopped.
notify.upd.rolled_back:
*Update rolled back – version {version}*
After the update the services were not running correctly. Affected services: {services}. The previous version ({previous}) was restored automatically. Your data, settings and wallet keys were not affected.
notify.upd.rollback_failed:
*Update failed and rollback unsuccessful (v{version})*
After the update the services were not running correctly, and restoring the previous version failed as well.
notify.upd.fetch_failed_repeated:
*Update check repeatedly failed*
The update source was unreachable for the last {attempts} attempts ({error}). This is usually a brief network hiccup or a temporarily exhausted request limit – a real update will not be missed, only detected later.

cli.lw.help:
FORGE Liquidity – manual withdrawal from a pool (bin/withdraw.js)

Withdraws part of the liquidity of an existing position via
decreaseLiquidity. The position stays open — only the given amount
is taken out. NO dry run by default – every call without
--dry-run executes real on-chain transactions.

Usage:
  node bin/withdraw.js --pool "SOL/USDC"   --usdc 100
  node bin/withdraw.js --pool "cbBTC/USDC" --usdc 200
  node bin/withdraw.js --pool "cbBTC/WBTC" --usdc 100 --dry-run
  node bin/withdraw.js --pool "SOL/USDC"   --token SOL --amount 0.5    (mode B)

Options:
  --pool <pair>     Pool pair (required)
  --usdc <amount>   Mode A: USDC value to withdraw
  --token <symbol>  Mode B: anchor token (tokenA or tokenB of the pool)
  --amount <amount> Mode B: amount of the anchor token
  Exactly one of --usdc or (--token + --amount) is required.
  --dry-run         Simulation: checks + calculation, no on-chain TX
  --json            Machine-readable output (for UI integration)
  --swap-to-usdc    Automatically swap the withdrawn coins to USDC afterwards
  --send-to <addr>  Send the withdrawn coins (or, with --swap-to-usdc: USDC) to this
                     address; without this option the coins stay in the wallet.
  --help, -h        This text, no withdraw run

Note: also works out of range — you then only receive the remaining
token (the other one is already fully converted).

cli.ld.help:
FORGE Liquidity – manual deposit into a pool (bin/deposit.js)

Adds capital to an existing position via increaseLiquidity,
or opens (with --new) a new position. NO dry run by default –
every call without --dry-run executes real on-chain transactions.

Usage:
  node bin/deposit.js --pool "SOL/USDC"    --usdc 500
  node bin/deposit.js --pool "cbBTC/USDC"  --usdc 200 --new
  node bin/deposit.js --pool "EURC/USDC"   --tokenb 85
  node bin/deposit.js --pool "EURC/USDC"   --usdc 100 --dry-run
  node bin/deposit.js --pool "SOL/USDC"    --token SOL --amount 0.5     (mode B)
  node bin/deposit.js --pool "cbBTC/WBTC"  --token cbBTC --amount 0.001 (mode B)

Options:
  --pool <pair>     Pool pair, e.g. "SOL/USDC" or "EURC/USDC"  (required)
  --usdc <amount>   Mode A: USDC budget (pre-swap into pool tokens)
  --tokenb <amount> Deposit a tokenB amount directly (legacy)
  --token <symbol>  Mode B: anchor token, counter amount follows the pool ratio
  --amount <amount> Amount of the anchor token (together with --token)
  Exactly one of --usdc / --tokenb / (--token + --amount) is required.
  --new             Allow a new position if none exists
  --dry-run         Simulation: all checks + calculations, no on-chain TX
  --json            Machine-readable output (for UI integration)
  --no-trailing-stop-default  Create trailing stop disabled on first deposit
  --no-tvl-protection-default Create TVL protection level 1 disabled on first deposit
  --help, -h        This text, no deposit run

Minimum amounts (mode A):
  - existing position, standard:      5 USDC
  - existing position, volatilePair: 10 USDC (2 swaps needed)
  - new position (--new):            20 USDC (plus account rent)
  - mode B: no minimum amounts (no swap)
